Face Recognition Door Locks

Face recognition models start at RM1,610 including installation. Structured-light 3D judges facial depth, so photos and screen replays are hard to pass, provided the doorway has standing distance and some light.

Models in this category

Check where people will stand

Consider where household members normally stand when they unlock the door. Show the installer any grille, opposite wall or narrow corridor that limits the standing distance.

Check the doorway by day and by night

Look at the lighting from the usual standing point. Share a photo and tell the installer when the entrance is strongly backlit or dim.

Choose a backup entry method

Pick a method for household members who may have difficulty using face recognition. The individual specifications show which models support fingerprints, PINs or cards.

Frequently asked questions

How much do these locks cost including installation?

The 10 models cost from RM1,610 to RM2,960 including installation.

What should I check before installation?

Consider where household members normally stand when they unlock the door. Show the installer any grille, opposite wall or narrow corridor that limits the standing distance.

What does the price include?

Installation is included with every smart lock at no extra charge. If your door needs drilling or alterations, we’ll discuss the work with you first.
